refused: firewall: ufw is installed but not active. The safe way: run admit again with --enable-ufw. It allows every port sshd listens on (22/tcp, 2222/tcp), arms a timer that turns ufw off again in 10 minutes, enables ufw, and stops the timer once a new SSH login gets through.
To enable it by hand instead, run these in this order:
  1. sudo ufw allow 22/tcp
  2. sudo ufw allow 2222/tcp
  3. sudo ufw enable
Enabling ufw without steps 1 and 2 cuts off SSH to this host, your own login included. Then run admit again. Nothing was changed
